tools.name: inspect_source
tools.description:
Explicitly inspect provider observations to answer a numerical data question.

    This is separate from metadata search. It loads only the exact supplied
    native sources and runs read-only SQL; no discovery, proxy choice or nested
    agent is invoked. Results certify only their actual loaded source/window and
    retain native duplicates/nulls. Use selected sources and supported native
    descriptors. A metadata range alone is insufficient for a numerical answer.
    A missing or rejected descriptor is an inspection-contract limitation,
    not evidence that the source has no data. Do not guess its selectors.

parameters.description:
Explicitly inspect provider observations to answer a numerical data question.

This is separate from metadata search. It loads only the exact supplied
native sources and runs read-only SQL; no discovery, proxy choice or nested
agent is invoked. Results certify only their actual loaded source/window and
retain native duplicates/nulls. Use selected sources and supported native

A missing or rejected descriptor is an inspection-contract limitation,
not evidence that the source has no data. Do not guess its selectors.

handles.description: Previously returned exact native probe/inspection handles, including their explicit window. Use sources for selected native records whose descriptors have not been prepared. Barchart handles require market_source, relation_role, asset_class and target_timeframe; study_assets also requires trading_hours and roll_mode/roll_days/roll_method/nth. For Barchart, kind/category/period must be empty and revision/index_by absent. Do not guess defaults or construct selectors from loader names. Supply handles or sources, not both.
handles.title: Handles

sources.description: Copy exact owned result_ref (or retained handoff_ref) and record_ref addresses from native search, then add the explicit retrieval window. The selected record must have a compatible native dataset binding; an identity-only row is not an inspection descriptor. Backend derives provider selectors from the owned native binding; no symbol or selector guessing. Omit window only for a windowless relation. Barchart additionally needs authored market_options because metadata does not define execution/reference relation selectors. Supply sources or already-returned handles, not both.
sources.title: Sources

queries.description: Read-only SELECT queries with source-native table/column names. Omit to describe the given exact relations and a small sample first. If any source fails preparation, explicit SQL is blocked; sample the returned healthy handles before authoring new SQL.
queries.title: Queries

parameters.title: inspect_source

tools.name: build_study
tools.description:
Build and save study definitions.

Use when:
Create needs a self-contained brief; update changes calculations, data
selection or outputs; clone makes a separately editable copy from a saved study
or authorized exemplar. New observations alone need no rebuild.

Behavior:
Brief native IDs/loaders/options, source qualifications and defaults. Preserve
custom addresses/types/clocks; saved tables use execution_input. Never copy vendor
payloads. The author owns implementation and presentation; describe results/methods.
The studies batch is sequential; preserve successful siblings. No interrupt.

Extra backtest presentation needs an explicit request. API and explicit MCP outputs must
match their accepted contract. Tables/JSON come from complete computed relations.
Standard Backtest, Monte Carlo and tuning dashboards and their grouped
interpretation are completed by Backend; they need no authored replacement summary.
For a new research study, the author constructs calculations, requested text and
output sinks together under the native contracts. Later analysis or output revisions
over a saved result use execution_input. Reuse its computed outputs; add needed
calculations. Inspect underlying inputs for a specific discrepancy or requested
audit. Further numerical calculations over a backtest's fills, trades or account
results require its completed execution. The author retains that evidence and
identifies required later work in final_note.
For grouped return summaries, include counts,
medians and share-positive measures when needed to interpret averages.

Returns:
Typed per-item outcomes distinguish saved definitions, source_catalogue reads,
failures and infeasibility. tables=[] inspects exact saved-source table choices
without authoring or saving. Only a saved outcome's slot_id feeds run_study.
Read final_note and material validation qualifications before execution,
including required post-run outputs. Resolve departures from approved requirements
before running; ask only for a material user choice, not routine caveats.

Recovery:
Correct only the failed item on the same study line, once, for typed input/binding
rejection, unavailable optional exemplar, or demonstrably agent-imposed author
constraint. Re-resolve a named missing selected source once; the same recovery covers
an omitted or mis-scoped source named by the closed result for an already-approved
requirement. Resolve only that need, exclude failed addresses, and retry the same
study line once. A changed concept, proxy or shorter coverage needs a user decision.
A second failed correction, uncertain write, or compiler/service/persistence fault
is not an automatic resubmission.
Preserve approved scope, method, costs and outputs; a changed requirement needs the
user's decision.

base.description: Clone source: curated exemplar, or saved-study slot. Must resolve; no scratch fallback.

name.description: Saved-study clone name; omit to preserve an authorized exemplar's approved name.
name.title: Name

change_directive.description: For a saved-study clone, state settled changes and new evidence while preserving other parent requirements. State removals/replacements explicitly. Omit for verbatim curated clones. Changed exemplar requirements use CREATE + exemplar_ids.
change_directive.title: Change Directive

execution_input.description: Research: {run_slot_id,tables} or {source_execution_id,tables}; additional_sources selects named runs for one comparison report.
execution_input.title: Execution Input

authoring_brief.description: Settled objective/scope, requested outputs, confirmed follow-ups. Sections: views, selected native IDs/loaders/options, custom addresses, source qualifications, methods/exhibits, supplied evidence. The author has no prior messages.
authoring_brief.title: Authoring Brief

exemplar_ids.description: Approved same-form examples already available; omit otherwise. Never invent IDs or inherit requirements. Examples grant no clone authority.
exemplar_ids.title: Exemplar Ids

ExemplarCloneBase.description: An exact curated EpochResearch exemplar selected for this clone slot.

authorization_ref.description: Current-turn exact-request exemplar-recall:... or unchanged legacy exemplar-confirmation:... ref.
authorization_ref.title: Authorization Ref

ExemplarCloneBase.title: ExemplarCloneBase

tables.description: Exact native table names. An empty list reads available tables and returns selection guidance without authoring, saving or executing a study.
tables.title: Tables

SavedStudyCloneBase.description: A Backend study already registered under a slot in this thread.

kind.description: Exact kind for an existing study saved in this thread: saved_study.
kind.title: Kind

SavedStudyCloneBase.title: SavedStudyCloneBase

StudyExecutionInputSelection.description: Study inputs already reject native extras; publish that exact closure.
StudyExecutionInputSelection.title: StudyExecutionInputSelection

StudyNamedExecutionInputSelection.description: Closed study argument using the native source fields and validators.
StudyNamedExecutionInputSelection.title: StudyNamedExecutionInputSelection

execution_input.description: Research: {run_slot_id,tables} or {source_execution_id,tables}; additional_sources selects named runs for one comparison report.
execution_input.title: Execution Input

change_directive.description: Self-contained settled changes, relevant new evidence and output requirements. Parent supplies unchanged code and requirements. State removals/replacements explicitly; do not repeat the full brief or refer to conversation history.
change_directive.title: Change Directive

name.description: Optional new name. Omit to preserve the Backend-owned parent name.
